card.name: "Required" in if-use-is-needed clauses
card.fires_on: The word required or necessary (sometimes used) right after "is" in an if/when clause about needing a drug, inhibitor or co-administration. The clause is followed by a dosing instruction.

modes.label: If inhibitor is required
modes.description: Conditional clause about needing a strong CYP inhibitor or interacting drug, ending in required.
modes.example: If treatment with a P-gp or strong CYP3A4 inhibitor is<< required>> in patients with normal renal and hepatic

modes.label: Is necessary
modes.description: Same kind of clause but ending in necessary or used.
modes.example: If concomitant use of CYP3A4 inhibitor is<< necessary>>, consider dosage reduction of acetaminoph
